name: AllowLatch
description: SERV Policy Copilot + spending turnstile for financial AI agents on Base (USDC). NL mandates → strict policy → ALLOW/DENY/ESCALATE + allow-receipt. Fail-closed clients. Prefer hybrid Spend Permissions + createGatedAgentKit (middleware alone is not custody-grade). End users need no API keys. OpenServ x402 + Coinbase AgentKit.

openserv.evaluatePack: buy_evaluate_pack — each paid $0.025 x402 mints fixed credits (default 3); client cannot choose amount
openserv.invoke: x402 payWorkflow with { prompt } - no end-user API keys; users never run the host
openserv.failClosed: timeout / network / malformed → DENY; check gate.isActive but still fail-closed on hang

websiteGate.sessionSeal: HMAC blob returned on apply/evaluate — client must send it back to survive Vercel cold starts
websiteGate.note: Always-on preferred Connect path after website Go live. assertSpend({ gateUrl, sessionSeal }). OpenServ x402 remains the paid marketplace path when the host is online.

skills.description: SERV: draft MandatePolicy with conflicts, assumptions, questions (Multipath, prompt_guard, shadow).
SERV: revise policy from owner feedback.
Persist MandatePolicy. First apply returns ownerToken (required for later mutates).
SERV: compile NL mandate into MandatePolicy JSON and store (requires ownerId / ownerToken).
Optional: mirror daily USDC cap into Coinbase Spend Permissions (requires ownerToken).
Deterministic allow | deny | escalate. Issues single-use allow-receipt on ALLOW. No transaction.
Paid x402 call mints fixed evaluate credits for packKey (client cannot choose amount).
SERV: explain a gate result; never overrides the verdict.
Re-evaluate, consume allow-receipt (jti), then AgentKit USDC transfer only on ALLOW (or escalate + humanApproved).
Audit events for a policyId (ownerToken) or global (operatorToken).
Reset day/hour windows only — lifetime budget preserved. Requires ownerToken.

invariants: Allow/deny/escalate is deterministic code - never LLM judgment
Execute requires verified single-use allow-receipt (or escalate + humanApproved)
Fail-closed: timeout, network error, malformed decision, or missing receipt → DENY
Receipt binds chain, action digest, and calldataHash for swaps; prefer tokenAddress over symbol
Tenant mutates require ownerToken (minted on first apply) or ALLOWLATCH_OPERATOR_TOKEN
Lifetime budget is not reset by public APIs; reset_daily_ledger clears day/hour only
End users never run npm run dev or set SERV_API_KEY — they discover hosted AllowLatch Gate
AllowLatch does not custody user funds or private keys
End users do not configure SERV_API_KEY or CDP - the host operator does; x402 pays the call
